changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate 'SberQuAd' (normalized to SberQuAD) and kept consistent dataset names
Normalized metric variants to base forms (BLEU4→BLEU, ROUGE L→ROUGE) per guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this paper; only human evaluation and automatic metrics

guideline: Annotators scored generated questions on a 3-point scale for grammaticality (grammatical correctness), understandability (whether the question is easy to understand by readers), and answerability (whether the question can be answered by the given input answer)

changes_made.explanation: Guideline consolidated into a single clear description; criteria list is accurate

overall_notes: The extraction quality is generally good. The paper focuses on paragraph-level question generation using sequence-to-sequence models. Key contributions include QG-Bench benchmark, extensive model evaluation across multiple languages/domains, and comprehensive human evaluation with correlation analysis between automatic metrics and human judgments. No LLM-as-judge evaluation is present.
